metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: GOCWAY crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C120 H76 Fe12 O62 S24 Sm4,C110 H70 Fe12 N2 O64 S22 Sm4,4(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Sm1 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe2 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe3 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe4 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe5 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe6 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Sm1A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm2A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Fe1A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe2A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe3A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe4A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe5A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe6A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Sm3 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm4 (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Fe7 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe8 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe9 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe10 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe11 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe12 (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Sm3A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Sm4A (Sm) has 8 O neighbors; Fe7A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe8A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe9A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe10A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe11A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors; Fe12A (Fe) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 92 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.848-4.201 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 91.04-132.90°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C238H158Fe24S46N6O126Sm8.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
